$comment: Contract A (spec §4.1), snapshot version 2 (#54 phase 1). Session snapshot the daemon writes to $PLUGIN_DATA/hud/<session_id>.json. No string fields, by design (I1). Cross-field rules per accounting_version are in hud_snapshot._parse and privacy_status.rs parse_v2: 0 has every quantity null and unverified true; 1 has numeric percent and legacy_prevented_rows and the other three null; 2 has a null legacy count, and a numeric percent only with unresolved_actions 0 and unverified false. Readers also accept the legacy version 1 document {v, percent, blocked, unverified, hidden, updated_at} as accounting 1.
